data.title: bn-3hd8: VmHWM peak keep max (kernel non-monotonic under reclaim)
data.description: VmHWM can be recomputed lower by recent kernels under heavy concurrent reclaim (fairness 64-writer cells, host kernel 7.1.4). process_delta kept max(before,after) instead of fail-stopping on the apparent rollback. Identity already verified equal (not PID reuse). Only VmHWM affected. unittest 48/48, runner 163/163, verifier 187/187, evaluator SELF_TEST_PASS.

data.reason: APPROVED. VmHWM (mm->hiwater_rss) is a peak the kernel can legitimately recompute lower under concurrent reclaim; the identity (pid+start_ticks) equality is checked upstream so this is not PID reuse. max(before,after) preserves the true peak with no loss of evidence. io/context-switch counters remain _delta-guarded (genuinely monotone); cancelled_write_bytes already signed. Regression test added. All suites green. open_findings=0
